usage: This is the most common way to say "please" or "excuse me" in Egyptian Arabic. It is used to politely ask for something, get a waiter's attention, or ask someone to move. It must agree with the gender and number of the person being addressed.

variants.label: to a man
variants.note: The standard form used when speaking to a single male.

variants.label: to a woman
variants.note: The standard form used when speaking to a single female.

variants.label: to a group
variants.note: Used when addressing two or more people.

variants.label: alternative (more formal)
variants.note: Slightly more formal, often used by service workers or when asking for a physical item.

variants.label: alternative (excuse me)
variants.note: Used when asking to pass by someone, interrupting, or politely requesting a favor.

examples.english: Please (to a group), open the door.
